preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 200000 and 1 <= m <= 200000 for n, m in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n and m are between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= val <= 10**9 for val in row) for row in all_rows)
preconditions.description: All cell values are positive integers between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(n * m for n, m in test_cases) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The sum of n*m over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and (line.strip() == '-1' or (len(line.strip().split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= m for x in line.strip().split()))) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either '-1' or two space-separated integers representing column indices between 1 and m.

postconditions.expression: all((output == '-1' and not any(is_good(grid, i, j) for i in range(m) for j in range(m))) or (output != '-1' and is_good(grid, int(output.split()[0])-1, int(output.split()[1])-1))) for grid, output in zip(all_grids, stdout_lines))
postconditions.description: If output is -1, no pair of columns (i, j) exists such that swapping them makes the grid good. If output is a pair (i, j), swapping columns i and j (0-indexed) results in a grid where every row is non-decreasing.
